name: Xander's museum
description: The Maestros' museum in Park Heights where Elspeth catalogues questionable art.

timeline.summary: Elspeth works as a museum recruit, cataloguing artwork that hints at Phyrexians, and decides the curator Xander knows more.
timeline.quote: The leader of the Maestros wasn't collecting all these relics by chance.

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth that to learn more she must work for it, and she agrees to take jobs that make her a true member of the family.
Xander tells Elspeth that New Capenna was founded by a deal between archangels and demonlords against an unknown enemy, and that he is one of the original signers.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I am, indeed, one of those original signers and have willingly become part demon

timeline.summary: Xander gives Elspeth Halo to drink, describing it as the last gift of the angels.
timeline.quote: "Halo was the last gift of the angels."

timeline.summary: Xander tells Elspeth about the Adversary and the Cabaretti's Font, and orders her to infiltrate the Cabaretti and leave a door unlocked.
timeline.quote: tell me where the Font is kept and leave a door unlocked.

timeline.summary: Xander names Elspeth an officer of the Maestros and gives her a knife; she demands full access to his archives in return for this last job.
timeline.quote: "Do this for me, and all the knowledge in my archives will be yours."
